description: A deeper Form 3 study of Kiswahili poetry covering its meaning, traditional and free verse forms, prosody (arudhi), stanza structures, figures of speech, themes, poetic style, and the analysis of poems.

options.text: Sanaa ya lugha inayotumia mpangilio maalumu wa maneno yenye mahadhi, vina na mizani kufikisha hisia na ujumbe
Hadithi ndefu ya kubuni iliyoandikwa kwa lugha ya kawaida
Maongezi ya kawaida kati ya watu wawili
Orodha ya methali na vitendawili vya jamii

mcq.explanation: Ushairi (poetry) is an art of language that uses a special arrangement of words with rhythm, rhyme and metre to convey emotions and a message.

mcq.questionText: Aina kuu mbili za ushairi ni zipi?

options.text: Ushairi wa kimapokeo na ushairi huru
Ushairi wa Kiingereza na ushairi wa Kiswahili
Ushairi wa watoto na ushairi wa watu wazima
Ushairi wa kuimba na ushairi wa kuandika

mcq.explanation: The two main types are ushairi wa kimapokeo (traditional poetry, which follows rules of rhyme and metre) and ushairi huru (free verse, which does not bind itself to those rules).

mcq.questionText: Katika shairi la kimapokeo, mstari mmoja kamili wa shairi huitwaje?
mcq.explanation: A single complete line of a poem is called mshororo (or mstari). A group of lines forms an ubeti (stanza).

mcq.questionText: Mizani katika ushairi wa kimapokeo ni nini?

options.text: Idadi ya silabi katika kipande au mshororo
Idadi ya beti katika shairi zima

mcq.explanation: Mizani is the count of syllables (silabi) in a kipande or mshororo. Equal mizani gives the poem its regular rhythm.

options.text: Idadi ya silabi za kila mshororo
Sauti zinazofanana mwishoni mwa vipande na mishororo

mcq.explanation: Vina are the matching sounds (rhyme) at the end of vipande (the cesura/middle rhyme) and at the end of mishororo (the end rhyme).

mcq.questionText: Mshororo unapogawanyika sehemu mbili, kila sehemu huitwaje?
mcq.explanation: When a mshororo is divided into two halves, each half is a kipande. The first is ukwapi and the second is utao, separated by a caesura.

options.text: Mshororo wa mwisho unaorudiwa katika kila ubeti
Silabi ya kwanza ya kila mshororo
Ubeti wa kwanza wa shairi pekee

mcq.explanation: Kibwagizo is the refrain: the last line (mshororo) that is repeated at the end of every stanza, often carrying the poem's central idea.

mcq.questionText: Ushairi huru hutofautiana vipi na ushairi wa kimapokeo?

options.text: Hauzingatii sheria za vina na mizani kwa ukamilifu
Lazima uwe na vina na mizani sawa kila mshororo
Huandikwa kwa lugha ya kigeni pekee

mcq.explanation: Free verse (ushairi huru) does not strictly observe the rules of rhyme (vina) and metre (mizani), giving the poet more freedom, though it still uses figurative language.

mcq.questionText: Soma ubeti huu: "Maji ni uhai wetu, tuyatunze kwa makini, / Vyanzo tusiviharibu, miti tupande shambani, / Kizazi kije baadaye, kinywe maji ya thamani, / Tuhifadhi mazingira, kwa faida ya wengi." Shairi lenye mishororo minne kila ubeti huitwaje?
mcq.explanation: A stanza with four lines (mishororo minne) is called tarbia. Tathlitha has three lines, takhmisa has five, and tasdisa has six.

mcq.questionText: Shairi lenye mishororo mitatu katika kila ubeti huitwaje?
mcq.explanation: Tathlitha is a poem with three lines per stanza. (Tathnia = two lines, tarbia = four, takhmisa = five.)

mcq.questionText: Katika mstari "Moyo wangu ni jiwe, halisikii huruma," tamathali iliyotumika ni ipi?
mcq.explanation: "Moyo wangu ni jiwe" (my heart is a stone) is sitiari (metaphor): a direct comparison without using words like 'kama' or 'mfano wa'.

mcq.questionText: Katika mstari "Macho yake yang'aa kama nyota angani," tamathali iliyotumika ni ipi?
mcq.explanation: The use of "kama" (like) to compare the eyes to stars makes this tashbiha (simile), an indirect comparison using words such as kama or mithili ya.

mcq.questionText: Katika mstari "Upepo ulinong'ona, ukaniambia siri," tamathali iliyotumika ni ipi?
mcq.explanation: Giving the wind the human ability to whisper and tell a secret is tashhisi (personification): assigning human qualities to non-human things.

mcq.questionText: Neno 'arudhi' katika taaluma ya ushairi lina maana gani?

options.text: Sheria au kanuni zinazoongoza utunzi wa mashairi ya kimapokeo
Mkusanyiko wa mashairi ya mtunzi mmoja
Sauti ya mwimbaji wakati wa kughani

mcq.explanation: Arudhi refers to the rules/conventions of prosody that govern traditional poetry, including vina, mizani, vipande and the structure of beti.

mcq.questionText: Katika uchambuzi wa shairi, 'dhamira' ina maana gani?

options.text: Idadi ya silabi katika kila mshororo
Wazo kuu au jambo analolizungumzia mtunzi katika shairi

mcq.explanation: Dhamira is the theme: the central idea or subject the poet addresses. A poem may have a main theme (dhamira kuu) and minor themes (dhamira ndogo).

fib.questionText: Ushairi unaozingatia sheria za vina na mizani huitwa ushairi wa _____.
fib.explanation: Poetry that follows the rules of rhyme and metre is traditional poetry (ushairi wa kimapokeo).

fib.questionText: Mstari wa mwisho unaorudiwarudiwa mwishoni mwa kila ubeti huitwa _____.
fib.explanation: The repeated last line at the end of each stanza is the refrain (kibwagizo).

fib.questionText: Idadi ya silabi katika kipande au mshororo huitwa _____.
fib.explanation: The number of syllables in a kipande or line is the metre (mizani).

fib.questionText: Sauti zinazofanana mwishoni mwa vipande na mishororo huitwa _____.
fib.explanation: Matching sounds at the ends of vipande and lines are the rhymes (vina).

fib.questionText: Kundi la mishororo linalounda fungu moja katika shairi huitwa _____.
fib.explanation: A group of lines forming one unit of a poem is a stanza (ubeti).

fib.questionText: Shairi lenye mishororo mitano katika kila ubeti huitwa _____.
fib.explanation: A poem with five lines per stanza is takhmisa.

fib.questionText: Tamathali ya kulinganisha vitu viwili kwa kutumia neno 'kama' huitwa _____.
fib.explanation: Comparing two things using a word like 'kama' (like) is simile (tashbiha).

fib.questionText: Tamathali ya kuvipa vitu visivyo na uhai sifa za binadamu huitwa _____.
fib.explanation: Giving human qualities to non-living things is personification (tashhisi).

fib.questionText: Kanuni au sheria zinazoongoza utunzi wa ushairi wa kimapokeo kwa ujumla huitwa _____.
fib.explanation: The body of rules governing traditional poetry composition is prosody (arudhi).

fib.questionText: Wazo kuu analolizungumzia mtunzi katika shairi huitwa _____.
fib.explanation: The central idea addressed by the poet is the theme (dhamira).

tf.questionText: Ushairi huru hauzingatii kikamilifu sheria za vina na mizani.
tf.explanation: True. Free verse (ushairi huru) does not bind itself strictly to the rules of rhyme and metre.

tf.questionText: Mshororo na ubeti ni maneno yenye maana moja kabisa.
tf.explanation: False. A mshororo is a single line, while an ubeti is a stanza made up of several mishororo.

tf.questionText: Kibwagizo ni mshororo unaorudiwa mwishoni mwa kila ubeti.
tf.explanation: True. The kibwagizo (refrain) is the repeated final line of each stanza.

tf.questionText: Tarbia ni shairi lenye mishororo mitatu katika kila ubeti.
tf.explanation: False. Tarbia has four lines per stanza; the three-line form is tathlitha.

tf.questionText: Sitiari hulinganisha vitu moja kwa moja bila kutumia maneno kama 'kama' au 'mfano wa'.
tf.explanation: True. Sitiari (metaphor) is a direct comparison without linking words like 'kama'.

tf.questionText: Kipande ni sehemu ya mshororo inayopatikana baada ya kuugawa mshororo katika sehemu mbili.
tf.explanation: True. A kipande is one of the two halves of a line divided at the caesura.

tf.questionText: Takriri ni tamathali ya kurudiarudia neno au fungu la maneno kwa lengo la kusisitiza.
tf.explanation: True. Takriri (repetition) repeats a word or phrase for emphasis.

tf.questionText: Mizani ni sauti zinazofanana mwishoni mwa mishororo.
tf.explanation: False. Those matching end sounds are vina (rhyme); mizani is the syllable count.

tf.questionText: Lugha ya kishairi mara nyingi hutumia tamathali za semi na taswira kuliko lugha ya nathari ya kawaida.
tf.explanation: True. Poetic language relies heavily on figures of speech and imagery, more so than ordinary prose.

tf.questionText: Katika uchambuzi wa shairi, dhamira na ujumbe ni dhana zinazohusiana lakini si sawa kabisa.
tf.explanation: True. Dhamira is the theme (what the poem is about) while ujumbe is the message/lesson the poet wants the reader to take; they are related but distinct.

summary.questionText: Eleza kwa ufupi maana ya ushairi.
summary.correctAnswer: Ushairi ni sanaa ya lugha inayotumia mpangilio maalumu wa maneno wenye mahadhi, vina, mizani na tamathali za semi ili kufikisha hisia, mawazo na ujumbe kwa msomaji au msikilizaji.
summary.explanation: A concise definition: poetry is a language art using a special, rhythmic arrangement of words with rhyme, metre and figurative language to convey emotions and a message.

summary.questionText: Taja aina mbili kuu za ushairi na utofautishe kwa ufupi.
summary.correctAnswer: Aina mbili ni ushairi wa kimapokeo na ushairi huru. Ushairi wa kimapokeo huzingatia sheria za vina na mizani, ilhali ushairi huru haufungwi na sheria hizo kwa ukamilifu.
summary.explanation: Names and contrasts the two main types: traditional (rule-bound) and free verse (unbound by strict rules of rhyme and metre).

summary.questionText: Eleza maana ya istilahi zifuatazo: mshororo na ubeti.
summary.correctAnswer: Mshororo ni mstari mmoja kamili wa shairi, nao ubeti ni kundi la mishororo linalounda fungu moja la shairi.
summary.explanation: Defines mshororo (a single line) and ubeti (a stanza, a group of lines).

summary.questionText: Eleza tofauti kati ya vina na mizani.
summary.correctAnswer: Vina ni sauti zinazofanana mwishoni mwa vipande na mishororo, nayo mizani ni idadi ya silabi katika kipande au mshororo.
summary.explanation: Distinguishes vina (rhyme sounds) from mizani (syllable count).

summary.questionText: Kibwagizo ni nini na kina umuhimu gani katika shairi?
summary.correctAnswer: Kibwagizo ni mshororo wa mwisho unaorudiwa katika kila ubeti. Umuhimu wake ni kusisitiza wazo kuu la shairi na kuleta mdundo na upatano katika shairi zima.
summary.explanation: Defines the refrain and explains its role in emphasising the central idea and giving rhythmic unity.

summary.questionText: Taja aina za mashairi kwa kuzingatia idadi ya mishororo katika ubeti (angalau tatu).
summary.correctAnswer: Tathnia (mishororo miwili), tathlitha (mishororo mitatu), tarbia (mishororo minne), takhmisa (mishororo mitano) na tasdisa (mishororo sita).
summary.explanation: Lists poem forms by line count per stanza: tathnia (2), tathlitha (3), tarbia (4), takhmisa (5), tasdisa (6).

summary.questionText: Eleza maana ya sitiari na tashbiha kwa kutoa mfano wa kila moja.
summary.correctAnswer: Sitiari ni ulinganishi wa moja kwa moja bila kutumia maneno kama 'kama', mfano: 'Maisha ni vita.' Tashbiha ni ulinganishi unaotumia maneno kama 'kama' au 'mithili ya', mfano: 'Ana nguvu kama simba.'
summary.explanation: Defines metaphor (direct comparison) and simile (comparison using 'kama'/'mithili ya') with one example each.

summary.questionText: Eleza maana ya tashhisi na takriri katika ushairi.
summary.correctAnswer: Tashhisi ni kuvipa vitu visivyo na uhai sifa au matendo ya binadamu, mfano: 'Mvua ilicheza ngoma.' Takriri ni kurudiarudia neno au fungu la maneno kwa lengo la kusisitiza.
summary.explanation: Defines personification (giving human traits to non-living things) and repetition (repeating words/phrases for emphasis).

summary.questionText: Eleza tofauti kati ya dhamira na ujumbe katika shairi.
summary.correctAnswer: Dhamira ni wazo kuu au jambo analolizungumzia mtunzi katika shairi, ilhali ujumbe ni funzo au wito ambao mtunzi anataka msomaji aupate baada ya kusoma shairi.
summary.explanation: Contrasts dhamira (theme/subject) with ujumbe (the lesson or call to action intended for the reader).

summary.questionText: Taja hatua kuu nne za kufuata wakati wa kuchambua shairi.
summary.correctAnswer: Kusoma shairi kwa makini kuelewa maudhui; kubainisha dhamira na ujumbe; kuchunguza fani kama vina, mizani, vipande na muundo; na kuchambua matumizi ya lugha na tamathali za semi.
summary.explanation: Outlines four key steps in analysing a poem: read for meaning; identify theme and message; examine form (rhyme, metre, structure); and analyse language and figures of speech.

hoq.questionText: Soma ubeti huu: "Elimu ni taa yetu, gizani inang'arisha, / Bila yake twapotea, njiani tunatangatanga, / Someni vijana wangu, maisha mtayafanya, / Elimu ni mwanga wetu, daima tuung'amshe." Ni tamathali gani kuu inayojitokeza katika mshororo wa kwanza na wa nne kuhusu elimu?

options.text: Sitiari, kwa kuifananisha elimu na taa/mwanga moja kwa moja
Tashbiha, kwa kutumia neno 'kama' kulinganisha elimu na taa
Tashhisi, kwa kuipa elimu sifa za binadamu
Kinaya, kwa kusema kinyume cha ukweli

hoq.explanation: "Elimu ni taa" and "Elimu ni mwanga" equate education directly with a lamp/light without using 'kama', so this is sitiari (metaphor), not simile. There is no human attribution (tashhisi) or contradiction (kinaya).

hoq.questionText: Soma ubeti huu: "Tunza mazingira yetu, miti usiyakate, / Maji safi yahifadhi, taka usiyatupe ovyo, / Hewa safi tuvute sote, afya yetu tutunze, / Dunia ni nyumba yetu, kwa wote tuilinde." Ubeti huu una mishororo mingapi, na shairi la aina hii huitwaje?
hoq.explanation: The stanza has four lines (mishororo minne), so a poem built of such stanzas is a tarbia. Counting the lines is the key analytical step here.

hoq.questionText: Soma ubeti huu: "Amani, amani, amani, ni hazina ya taifa, / Vita vyaleta machozi, na nyumba zaporomoka, / Tushikane mikono sote, chuki tuziache mbali, / Amani ndio msingi, wa maendeleo ya kweli." Ni dhamira na tamathali gani vinavyojitokeza kwa pamoja katika ubeti huu?

options.text: Dhamira ya umoja na amani; takriri katika kurudia neno 'amani'
Dhamira ya mapenzi; tashbiha ya kulinganisha amani na vita
Dhamira ya elimu; tashhisi ya kuyapa machozi uhai
Dhamira ya umaskini; sitiari ya kuita amani hazina

hoq.explanation: The dominant theme (dhamira) is unity and peace (umoja na amani), and the repetition of 'amani' at the start is takriri used for emphasis. While 'amani ni hazina' contains a metaphor, the standout figure paired with the unity theme is the takriri.
